answer: In this PoA design, an agent identity is issued only after remote attestation proves that a designated enclave runs approved code, binding its public key to the enclave’s MRENCLAVE measurement. A copied virtual machine cannot reproduce that hardware-rooted identity or pass attestation; creating another valid identity requires purchasing or provisioning genuine TEE-capable physical silicon rather than duplicating software. cedar, saffron, and garden identify separate deployments, not aliases.
